overview.text: National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD) Department of Information Technology is inviting bids.
The purpose of this RFP is to supply Red Hat JBoss Enterprise Application Platform and Extended Life Support Subscriptions.
The tender period is for one year.
NABARD intends to upgrade from the previous JBoss 5 version which went out of support in 2019.
NABARD is inviting bids for procurement of subscription services for Red Hat JBoss Enterprise Application Platform (JBOSS EAP) and ELS for one year.
The Technical Bid will be evaluated only for bidders who submit an Earnest Money Deposit (EMD).
The opening of the Technical Bid is scheduled to be held online on the portal at NABARD Head Office, Bandra-Kurla Complex, Mumbai.
The document describes an Integrity Pact agreement between NABARD (Buyer) and Bidders/Contractors to prevent corruption.
The Independent External Monitor (IEM) appointed for this pact is Shri Jagdeep Kumar Ghai, PTA & FS(Retd).
The Integrity Pact begins when both parties have legally signed it.
The pact expires for the Contractor 12 months after the last payment under the contract and for all other Bidders 6 months after the contract has been awarded.
The Buyer is National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD).
The document establishes confidentiality obligations, intellectual property rights, and remedies for the System Integrator regarding information shared with NABARD.
The agreement remains binding and applies without limit in point of time upon termination.
Dispute resolution is conducted through sole arbitration in English at Mumbai under the Indian Arbitration and Conciliation Act 1996.
NABARD (National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development) floated a Request for Proposal (RFP) to appoint a System Integrator.
The RFP Reference Number is specified in the document but left as a blank field 'RFP Ref No. __________________'.
A Performance Bank Guarantee (PGB) form was executed where the Bank guarantees payment to NABARD for the contractor's performance.
The document is a Service Level Agreement (SLA) between NABARD and a Service Provider.

NABARD is the First Party, identified as National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development established under the Act of Parliament i.e., National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development Act, 1981.
The agreement was entered into pursuant to a Principal Agreement/RFP/Purchase Order issued by NABARD via reference number (redacted) dated (redacted).
The project involves supply, implementation, and enabling support services related to Red Hat JBoss EAP support subscription and Red Hat JBoss EAP Extended Life Support (ELS) support subscription.
NABARD is the issuing organization requesting the Service Provider to perform these support services.
The document outlines operational terms for NABARD regarding inspection, support, performance measurement, and periodic review processes.
The SLA is an operational document to be reviewed at a minimum once per fiscal year.
The agreement defines conditions under which NABARD may cancel or terminate the Purchase Order/Contract at any time.
Termination occurs if there is a delay in project implementation beyond specified periods due solely to the Service Provider.
NABARD may terminate if the Service Provider fails to upgrade critical software within the specified period or extensions.
Contract termination is applicable if after-sales and maintenance calls are not attended for three or more occasions, with a 30-day notice.
The contract may be terminated if NABARD notes serious discrepancies in project implementation.
The agreement is governed by the laws of India.
Disputes shall be resolved amicably within a settlement period of 30 days between senior representatives.
Unresolved disputes must be referred to arbitration by a sole arbitrator under the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996.
The seat, venue, jurisdiction, and language of proceedings are all set in Mumbai, India.

scope.text: Supply of Red Hat JBoss EAP support subscription.
Supply of Red Hat JBoss EAP Extended Life Support (ELS) support subscription.
The vendor must supply support subscriptions for Red Hat JBoss EAP and ELS as per specified specifications and quantities within 48 hours from the issue of contract/purchase order.
The subscription services are valid for a period of one year from the date of activation unless otherwise specified in the purchase order.

The vendor shall ensure all subscriptions remain valid for the duration specified in the purchase order and provide access to Red Hat support services including upgrades, updates, patches, and technical assistance.
Deliverables include valid support subscription for JBoss EAP and ELS, access credentials and documentation for Red Hat support services, and compliance/audit documentation related to subscriptions.
Bidders/Contractors commit to preventing corruption and observe principles during tender participation and contract execution.
The pact begins when both parties sign it, expires for Contractors 12 months after the last payment, and for other Bidders 6 months after award.
Bidders must not directly or indirectly offer benefits to Buyer's employees in exchange for advantages during tender or contract execution.
Bidders cannot enter undisclosed agreements with other bidders regarding prices, specifications, or competition actions.
The System Integrator and NABARD are collectively referred to as 'the Parties'.
Confidential Information includes data, documents, and information explicitly designated as 'Confidential' obtained during the course of engagement.
The scope includes intellectual property, technical/business information, proprietary/internal info regarding products/services, security policies, and organizational charts.
Information regarding NABARD and its Affiliates, customers, and their accounts is treated as Confidential Information irrespective of marking.
Confidential Information includes NABARD, its affiliates, customers, business processes, plans, personnel, financial info, and capital adequacy workings.
The System Integrator must not commercially use or disclose Confidential Information to anyone other than directly employed persons with a need-to-know.
News releases, public announcements, interviews, and advertisements are prohibited without prior written approval from NABARD.

The System Integrator shall not make news releases, public announcements, give interviews, issue or publish advertisements or publicize in any other manner whatsoever in connection with this Agreement.
The scope of works specified in the tender involves software development and maintenance as indicated by clauses regarding software failure and contract terms.
The PGB covers payment for loss or damage caused to NABARD due to contractor's failure to perform works as per the contract.
The Service Provider is engaged as a System Integrator, Reseller, and Supplier.

The project involves the supply, implementation, and enabling support services related to Red Hat JBoss EAP support subscription and Red Hat JBoss EAP Extended Life Support (ELS) support subscription.
The scope includes maintenance, support, and upgradation of the subscribed software.
Support services include any installation or service which makes good failed service pre-agreed or requested by NABARD.
Services include supply, implementation, commissioning, maintenance of software, and maintenance of desired service levels to provide quality customer service to NABARD.
The Scope of Work outlines details on Support Services including Service Levels, Expected Deliverables, and Timelines.
Service Provider must provide timely support or enable OEM support for Red Hat JBoss EAP subscriptions as the Vendor/System Integrator.
Support Services include advisory and consultancy services to be mutually agreed upon between parties.
Service Provider must provide electronic books of accounts, log-books, and operating records relating to Support Services.
NABARD shall provide the Service Provider with necessary access to its Personnel and equipment, including dial-in capabilities.
The Scope of Work includes monitoring, tracking, and providing reports on performance parameters during the Warranty and Support period.
Services are restricted to OEM Licensed products and services thereof; modified software is excluded.
Service Provider liability to meet SLAs is limited to 10% of the agreement cost for the year of subscription.
The Service Provider must provide Support Services in the premises of NABARD or an enclosed environment with restricted access.
NABARD is entitled to terminate the contract if the Service Provider fails to provide after-sales and maintenance services.
The Scope includes ensuring that core systems or core business of NABARD are not adversely affected by the project.
Termination conditions include a breach in the terms and conditions of the Purchase Order.
Scope includes support services for Red Hat JBoss EAP support subscription and Red Hat JBoss EAP Extended Life Support (ELS) support subscription.
In the event of termination, a Reverse Transition Mechanism requires the Service Provider to deliver data in readable format along with knowledge documents within one month (unless extended).
The Reverse Transition Mechanism involves services and tasks required for the smooth handover of NABARD's deliverables and maintenance, lasting for a period of 3 months post the notice period.
Supplier must bear the entire cost of transportation from the port of discharge to the destination.
